_comment: Real, public X accounts that post XRP/FXRP calls. `scripts/ingest-x.ts` reads this list.
⚠️ These are real people, so three rules apply that do not apply to seeded data:
1. Only their own posts count. Retweets and replies are dropped by the ingester —
amplifying someone else's call is not making one, and scoring it against them
2. No wallet goes in without a self-disclosure URL (HANDOFF.md §2.2). None of these
have one here, so `wallet` stays null and said-vs-did correctly reports
'no wallet disclosed' rather than inferring anything.
3. Every stored post keeps its real platform id and URL, and `synthetic = 0`, so the
UI links to the actual post and a reader can check the extraction against it.
